evidence_refs.quote: Feathery is an AI operating and decisioning system purpose-built for financial services enterprises. Insurance and wealth management firms use Feathery to automate data collection, document processing, onboarding experiences, and operational workflows while integrating seamlessly with existing systems.

Its AI Decisioning System analyzes business data flowing through the platform, surfaces strategic insights and recommendations, and continuously feeds those learnings back into workflows to drive greater automation and efficiency.
Carriers throw away most of what's in a submission. Our new product reads all of it and shows you exactly which risk characteristics are driving your quote and bind rates.

Parabola , a San Francisco-based startup that uses AI to help expedite back-office processes, particularly in the logistics and e-commerce sectors

the platform applies AI to automate various workflows. Using Parabola, customers can take documents like PDFs, text message logs, images and emails and have Parabola standardize, enrich or categorize them.
The platform offers a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface, eliminating the need for tedious manual work.
